body.name: One-unseen-row compatible RSCM class
body.construction: \(Mone=\{M: M\text{ is a finite RSCM over }S\text{ and }G;\ M\text{ induces the source groundings }Rsrc\text{ and target grounding }\rho\text{ encoded by }Ictx;\text{ all of its exogenous noises are mutually independent; it has no exogenous relational parent and no non-relational exogenous parent shared by distinct ground endogenous variables; it has type-shared mechanisms; it reproduces }Psrc;\text{ it uses the rows }K\text{ recovered from positive-probability source parent contexts; and it has exactly one unrestricted target-relevant binary row at }rstar\}\).
